notes: Fixed: Waves (waves.com) now logs. Product pages read the price from the page's screen-reader label (Waves draws cents in superscript, so "$99<sup>99</sup>" would have read as $9999), and grid cards are no longer skipped because of their Add to Cart link. Any store whose cards link to a cart, checkout or wishlist page benefits too, and grid item names no longer come from review-count labels.
